title: New in Symfony 8.2: Firewalls and Routes
content:
<html><head></head><body>Symfony 8.2 connects firewalls and routes more closely: routes can choose
their firewall, you can load the routes of all firewalls with a single import,
and redirecting anonymous users to a login page no longer requires a custom class.

Selecting the Firewall…</body></html>
author: Javier Eguiluz
